accounting.cost_basis: one-way full-L1 target changes without division by2, including entries, mandatory changes and final liquidation
accounting.lag1: idealized observed-close fill, not a guaranteed one-hour wait
accounting.lifecycle: preserve source permissions, venue bridges, mandatory exits, migration cash gaps and rewarm rules; no fills or window shortening

chronology.correction: Existing verifier tests decoded the seven source panels and saved daily factor inputs and recalculated saved nine-strategy statistics before this study execution seal. No all-22 actual-price targets or performance were calculated before that seal. Later sealing cannot repair the pre-panel chronology gate failure.
chronology.disclosure: The strategy code/settings seal preceded the first all-22 simulation, but prior verification tests had already decoded actual source and saved data. Strict pre-panel-access compliance is false.

historical_interpretation: Established labels retained, but all three historical windows were previously examined. This is a later fixed-specification study, not new unseen OOS confirmation. No new winner, portfolio combination or correlation conclusion is selected.

inference.BTC_attribution: descriptive full-period strategy-return OLS against BTC returns, Bartlett HAC7 without finite covariance correction; annual alpha uses 365 and coefficient intervals are marginal 95%
inference.intervals: saved 95% marginal percentile raw Sharpe intervals, 10,000 circular 28-day blocks; NumPy PCG64 seed 20261020 reset per period; 252 endpoints are positive-scale transforms of 365 endpoints
inference.mean: saved descriptive calendar Bartlett HAC27 mean t-statistics with n/(n-1) covariance correction
inference.scope: descriptive uncertainty conditional on the specified strategy and supplied dataset, not adjusted for earlier basket/parameter research

limitations: inherited historically chosen universe and previous project inspection
fixed supplied Binance spotUSDT normalized latest study dataset, not pointintime certified
theoretical shorting; no realized borrow/funding/margin constraints
idealized observedclose execution; no orderbook slippage/depth/capacity or ordinarydriftmaintenance
partial-year2026 has273days and about9.75blocklengths; marginal conditional uncertainty not originalsearch adjusted

performance.max_drawdown: hourly valuation endpoints including initial NAV; intra-hour path unknown
performance.returns: strategy compounded returns net of transaction costs, with gross returns reported separately
performance.sharpe252: Sharpe365*sqrt(252/365), using the same complete daily sample including weekends
performance.sharpe365: sqrt(365)*mean(complete UTC daily returns)/sample_sd(complete UTC daily returns)
performance.turnover: full-L1 unit-notional changes, annualized as sum(turnover)*365/elapsed calendar days, including initial and terminal changes

publication_scope: Saved fixed-strategy performance, descriptive uncertainty, settings, chronology and source provenance. No new strategy execution, statistical test, parameter selection or source-data acquisition.

signal.clock: Monday 00:00 UTC; epoch2022-01-03T00:00:00Z, phase0; preserve warmup Mondays
signal.direction: long relative winners; short relative losers

panels.role: Complete 22-slot hourly universe for the tiered eight-coin basket search; each frozen strategy uses eight slots and the nine-strategy union has 21.
panels.source: Binance Vision normalized hourly endpoints and audited lifecycle masks
